text: With m2 in [0.1, 1], energy = -m2/(2a) never beats its best-of-5 control in 5000 steps (margin 0.088 vs required 0.1, control 0.666), even though distance and accel_step margins are 0.18-0.19. Is m2 itself linearly decodable above control in this model? If it is not, does that limit both energy and any m2-weighted part of the force signal?
